HeroDesktop.pText1: Effective face and body treatments. Tailored programs for rejuvenation, body contouring, and skin care, with no lengthy recovery.

Programm.headerText2: and that you can pass on
Programm.paragraphText1: PALIY Academy is for those who want to start a career in permanent makeup or take their skills to the next level.
Programm.paragraphText2: Our courses cover more than technique: we focus on client care, proper practice, hygiene, attention to detail, and natural-looking results.

Sale.headerText1: Now is the right time to do
Sale.paragraphText1: Explore current offers from PALIY ESTHETIC CLINIC.
Sale.paragraphText2: Offers are available for a limited time and may apply to selected treatments or dates.

Service.paragraphText1: We tailor every treatment to your needs, features, and expectations. Our goal is not dramatic change, but harmony, naturalness, and a beautiful result that lasts.

Slushba.paragraphText1: Personal care, modern technology, and natural-looking results. We perform every treatment with care for your safety, precision, and natural beauty.

Videos.paragraphText1: The best way to see our work is to see real results. Browse before-and-after photos from selected treatments.

id14.title: Cosmetology
id14.description: Discover professional cosmetology focused on the health, beauty, and natural appearance of your skin. Our modern treatments are tailored to each client and help improve the skin, support renewal, and restore freshness and vitality.

id15.title: Training
id15.description: We offer professional training in modern cosmetology methods and practical skin-care skills. Our courses are for beginners and experienced specialists who want to broaden their knowledge, learn new techniques, and build confidence working with clients under expert guidance.

id16.title: Permanent makeup
id16.description: Permanent makeup is a modern cosmetic treatment that enhances natural facial features and creates a polished look without daily makeup. Special pigments are used to shape and colour the brows and lips or define the lash line, with a focus on a natural result that suits your features. Each treatment is tailored to your skin, preferences, and desired look for a soft, elegant finish.
